messages:
tara (Product): OptimaHealth asked for per-tenant routing + immutable audit bundles for Private (HIPAA). They're saying other vendors already offer this as a checkbox. Link to RFP: https://optimahealth.example/rfp/112 :hospital:

samir (Sales): commercial note: it's a $200k ARR upside plus potential Dedicated deal. They're pushing deadline next quarter.

pat (Eng Runtime): technical quick take: per-tenant routing is mostly routing rules + metadata, but doing strict isolation + guarantees is heavier (KV cache separation, warm pools). Estimate: MLP with soft isolation ~ 5 dev-weeks; strict isolation + perf isolation ~ 3 months.

neil (Eng Platform): audit bundles: we have per-org audit logs in Private roadmap. Immutable, tamper-evident bundles for HIPAA need signed manifests + retention controls. infra effort 2-3 sprints to add export signing + lifecycle.

jin (Legal): HIPAA requires auditability + access controls; immutability helps but we also need BAA language and retention policy. I can draft pilot BAA addendum but need product to define what we're promising.

amy (Design): from UX: if we surface per-tenant routing, customers expect an easy "create tenant" flow + route rules UI. I can do a compact UX for pilot (tenant list + rule editor + signed-audit download) in 1 sprint.

tara (Product): thinking tradeoffs: competitor parity vs differentiated offering. Options: A) Ship org-level immutability + tenant-tagged metrics (fast, lower risk), B) Ship per-tenant isolation & immutable bundles (higher value, higher cost). Proposed MLP: Option A for pilot to get deal; commit to roadmap for B if telemetry & commercial signal validate. Goal: 6-8 weeks to pilot.

samir (Sales): OptimaHealth prefers B but will accept A if we give a clear timeline to B. They want a signed timeline in pilot paperwork.

pat (Eng Runtime): measurable risks for A: label cardinality, cross-tenant latency noise. I'll spin a spike to quantify latency delta and cardinality cost. ETA 7 working days.

neil (Eng Platform): infra spike to prototype signed audit export + manifest schema. ETA 10 working days.

jin (Legal): I'll draft a pilot addendum that reflects Option A + a commitment roadmap milestone for B. Need product wording for the commitment window.

tara (Product): next steps: - samir: confirm Optima will accept MLP A if we include a 3-month roadmap commitment to B (owner) - pat + neil: run spikes and share perf/cardinality data (owners) - amy: deliver pilot UX mock and acceptance criteria - jin: prep pilot addendum draft - I'll write pilot checklist and success metrics. Reconvene + sync in 11 days. :spiral_calendar:

ops-bot: scheduled: runtime-cardinality-spike started by pat at 2149623468

tara (Product): if spikes look good we'll offer a 6-week pilot with org-level immutability + tenant-tagged metrics and explicit follow-up milestone. If not, fallback: PS-assisted strict isolation. :handshake:
